# Invented for tests. Not a real book.
=== page 1 ===
Little Fox lived at the edge of the wood.
Every night the wood was dark, dark, dark.
[illustration: a small fox at a burrow door, the wood black behind]
=== page 2 ===
"Who will light the wood?" asked Little Fox.
Nobody answered. Only the wind said whoosh.
=== page 3 ===
Little Fox found a lantern under a root.
It was cold. It was dusty. Was it broken?
[illustration: the lantern half buried, a beetle on top]
=== page 4 ===
He rubbed it. He shook it. He blew on it.
Nothing. The wood was dark, dark, dark.
=== spread 5-6 ===
Then Owl flew down and said, "Lanterns need friends."
Owl tapped it once. Light spilled everywhere!
[illustration: full spread of the wood lit gold, every animal looking up]
=== page 7 ===
Now every night, Little Fox and Owl light the wood together.
And the wood is not so dark, dark, dark.
